name: user_id
description: MongoDB ObjectId of the user. Primary key.

name: anonymous_ids
description: All anonymous identifiers ever stitched to this user (for cross-device analysis)

name: first_seen_at
description: Timestamp of the user's first tracked event. Partition field.

name: last_seen_at
description: Timestamp of the user's most recent tracked event

name: lifetime_value
description: Total revenue across all paid orders (lifetime value)

name: first_touch_source
description: Attribution source at first ever conversion (first-touch model)

name: first_touch_medium
description: Attribution medium at first ever conversion

name: last_touch_source
description: Attribution source at most recent conversion (last-touch model)

name: last_touch_medium
description: Attribution medium at most recent conversion

name: last_touch_campaign
description: UTM campaign at most recent conversion

name: avg_confidence_score
description: Average attribution confidence score across all orders
